policies.detail: You must first find your own internship or training position at an eligible U.S. company. InterExchange does not offer placement.

requirements.description: You must apply from outside the USA. InterExchange cannot assist with a change of status from another visa.
Hospitality and tourism programs cannot exceed 12 months, for both Intern and Trainee.
Previous Intern or Trainee participants must wait at least 2 years after the end of a previous program before reapplying.

fee_schedules.label: Career Training USA 2026 program fees (standard)
fee_schedules.notes: A $300 nonrefundable application fee is due with your application and is applied to the total program fee, so it is not an additional cost. Applying through an attorney or an international cooperator may change the price. The sponsor lists miscellaneous fees that apply to some participants without naming them, so this estimate may be incomplete.
